label: How a recording is trimmed and how several are joined into one

params.name: max_parts
params.label: How many pieces may be joined at once

params.name: fade_seconds
params.label: Sound faded in and out at each cut, so it does not click

params.name: width
params.label: The picture size everything is brought to before joining

params.name: fps
params.label: Frames a second in the joined video

params.name: sample_rate
params.label: Sound samples a second in the joined video

params.name: exact
params.label: Cut exactly where asked (re-encodes) instead of at the nearest keyframe (instant)

params.name: end_tolerance_seconds
params.label: How far past a recording's end a cut may be asked for before it is refused

params.name: whole_tolerance_seconds
params.label: A piece this close to the whole recording is joined whole, not cut

description_nl: Trim keeps one stretch of a recording; Combine puts several one after another. Joining needs every piece to agree on size, frame rate and sound rate, so each is brought to the numbers here first - that is why a joined video is re-encoded while a plain trim with exact off is instant. With exact on, a trim lands on the frame asked for; with it off, it lands on the nearest keyframe, which can be a second out.
weight_basis: Owner-only (audience admin): these numbers decide how much CPU every cut and join costs on a server the owner pays for, and whether the result plays everywhere.
